name: Paper Blue
tagline: adu-motion-video's default route: paper white, ink, one blue, mono labels, a new visual event every 2–4 seconds.

motion.direction: adu-motion-video default route. Paper `#F7F7F5`, ink titles 600–800 with tight tracking (−1 to −6 px), grey mono labels (`// 02 — measured`), blue `ter` for the keyword and `slam` emphasis, red `goldd` ONLY for negation (`strikeLine`), green only for PASS. A new visual event every 2–4 s; the keyword lands the moment it is spoken; entrances 0.55 s expo (up / left / pop / slam / mask), transitions wipe or circle from the speaker; counters on numbers; a segment tag top-left per chapter (`chapterCard`); progress line. Phrase subtitles, no karaoke. Never stretch the person; the first frame shows person + claim.
